summary: Applications for Payment V2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — reference dropdowns, full math regression (grossValuation 60000, grossIncludingVariations 65000, thisPeriod 45000, totalRetention 3250, retentionThisPeriod 2250, subtotalNet 42250, labourRatio 0.667, cisDeduction 5633.33, vatAmount 7323.33, totalDue 43940.00), AFP-NNN auto-generated reference (incrementing per user via $inc), full status flow Draft→Submitted→Certified→Paid with Certified auto-stamping certifiedDate + copying totals.totalDue into certifiedAmount, Paid auto-stamping paidDate and incrementing the linked job's amountPaid, Overdue filter returns only past-due Submitted/Certified rows with isOverdue=true enriched flag, Variation Orders V2 auto-pull: when AFP omits approvedVariationsValue and links a project with an Approved VO, backend fills approvedVariationsValue from db.variation_orders (verified £1000 auto-pulled → grossIncludingVariations 3000), Reverse charge VAT yields vatAmount=0 and totalDue = subtotalNet - cisDeduction, template CRUD works. Frontend: dashboard renders all 6 stat cards (Draft/Submitted/Certified/Paid/Overdue/Rejected), 3 value cards (Outstanding/Overdue/Paid year-to-date), search + status filter (with 'Overdue' option) + project filter + New Application CTA, legacy /app/tool/application-for-payment redirects to /app/applications-for-payment, wizard opens & walks all 9 steps (Project→Contract→History→Valuation→Money→Docs→Approval→Status→Generate), Save & Generate PDF closes wizard and shows new row (AFP-014 £5,700.00 Draft), row Submit→Certify→Paid quick actions each update badge and stat cards live (Draft 1→0, Submitted 0→1→0, Certified 0→1→0, Paid 0→1). No console errors. Test rows cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: applications_for_payment.py is well-scoped (~610 lines) with clear separation between totals math, CRUD, status flow, project summary, and templates. _shape() correctly strips ObjectId.
_compute_totals correctly computes CIS on labour portion only via labourRatio × subtotalNet — matches spec and the £43,940 regression exactly.
AFP-NNN counter uses find_one_and_update with $inc — atomic and race-safe.
Auto-pull of approvedVariationsValue only fires when the client omits/0's the value — good idempotency, allows manual override.
Certified auto-copy of totals.totalDue into certifiedAmount only fires when not explicitly provided; Paid falls back to certifiedAmount then totals.totalDue.
job amountPaid $inc is wrapped in try/except so an orphaned projectId won't 500 the status change.
GET /jobs/{id} returns {job, documents} envelope — clients calling this need to unwrap; test updated accordingly.

ApplicationsForPayment.jsx is ~850 lines and approaching the 700-line guideline — same feedback as VariationOrders.jsx and RiskRegister.jsx: consider splitting the 9 wizard steps into subcomponents for maintainability.
All interactive elements have afp-* data-testids as specified, including per-line inputs, per-row action buttons, status buttons, and modal steps.
seed_data_creation: Backend test file creates TEST_-prefixed AFPs, jobs, one Variation Order, and one template. All are soft-deleted / DELETE'd in the terminal test. UI walkthrough created TEST_UI_AFP Project (AFP-014) and cleaned it up via delete quick action.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_applications_for_payment.py runs against public URL (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env), self-cleans, and covers reference, math regression, ref auto-gen, status flow with job amountPaid $inc, Overdue filter, Variation Orders auto-pull, reverse-charge VAT, and templates. AFP frontend testids all use 'afp-' prefix. PDF generation via jsPDF is a browser download — tested via 'wizard closes + row appears' rather than checking the bytes.
